text.text_excerpt: Delicious, delicious, delicious! Had the pleasure of ordering my quarantined birthday dinner from Blue Giant today. We got the Shrimp Fried Rice (tastes almost smoky, I don't really know how to describe it, and it was phenomenal) We also got the Kung Pao chicken, which was a common meal to get from any Chinese restaurant, however Blue Giant's Kung Pao tastes super "clean" it wasn't greasy-- as other Chinese restaurant tend to be. We also got the Dry Chili Wings and it is HOT! But it's the kind of hot that makes you want to keep eating, I could not get enough of it. (Thank god I was home, cause I think I drank about a gallon of water lol) Overall, this place is amazing. Worth me trying to ...

Finally got to go back in person to eat lunch at Blue Giant. After making reservations the day before (we were going for Friday lunch and didn't want to wait), we were promptly seated in our booth. Both sides of the booth have plexiglass going up to separate you from the other diners on either side of you and each table has a nice spray hand sanitizer to use. I started off with a rose mint tea daiquiri which was nice and refreshing. For food we each got an eggroll (these were massive and we easily could have split one), an order of the pork dumplings, Dan Dan noodles, and dry chili chicken. The server asked if we were okay with heat which was nice but we knew exactly what we were getting ...

Listen. This place is legit y'all! I was craving Chinese food bad, and all of my normal faves were closed (Dian Xin, Red's Chinese). I searched for places for literally hours before I decided on Blue Giant, even though I was a little skeptical about the prices and if the food would be as good as take out. It was more than worth it -- I'm already thinking about when I can order take out from them. The food was tasty, and even some of the littler portions were so good that I didn't even mind that they were a little smaller.
